name: Cambria Cazabon
career: Firmware QA Engineer for smart-home devices
bio: Cambria spends her workdays stress-testing appliance firmware, then unwinds by sending her friends dramatic storytelling comedy clips and brutally honest voice notes about their dating choices. She keeps a rotating folder of braided hairstyle tutorials, gym lifting plans, and makeup hacks, though she is more consistent with leg day than with cleaning her apartment. Her faith is central to how she frames relationships, and she has a soft spot for Nigerian romance dramas with loyal, expressive couples. Surprisingly, she also restores old mechanical keyboards and once drove three hours in her Nissan Rogue just to buy a rare set of translucent keycaps.
